name: Trader
about: Buys what the village has too much of, sells what it has too little of, under a travel-cloak with more pockets than a coat has any right to and a belt-knife for cutting rope, not throats.
gossip: Prices are better two valleys over. They always are, until you get there.
Anything that comes out of the ground is cheap where it comes out.
I will take mushrooms off your hands. I will not pretend to be pleased about it.
